label: Base rate entity aggregated turnover threshold
notes: Aggregated turnover must be less than this amount. The page prints $50m, so the record has no pattern. A base rate entity also needs base rate entity passive income of 80% or less of its assessable income. The $50 million threshold in Income Tax Rates Act 1986 s 23AA(b) applies from the 2018-19 year of income (Treasury Laws Amendment (Enterprise Tax Plan) Act 2017, No. 41, 2017, Sch 1 items 16 and 57(3)): https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2017A00041/asmade
